testimonials.t1Text: The monthly serving rota used to be me in Excel until midnight, then calling everyone one by one to confirm. David's system now assigns shifts automatically and sends LINE reminders — swapping a shift takes one tap on your phone. He listened to our needs over and over without getting tired of it. An engineer who thinks from the user's side.
testimonials.t2Text: The scariest part of a replatform is the online business going down. David walked through our entire workflow before writing a single line of code — we didn't lose one order during the switchover week. I now update prices and check stock myself, no more waiting on a developer. Message him on LINE and you usually hear back the same day. That still puts my mind at ease.
testimonials.t3Text: Our inventory system ran for over a decade and everyone said 'if it works, don't touch it.' David was willing to interview every department before starting. Three months after launch, stocktaking went from two days to half a day, and reports no longer get retyped by hand. The rarest part: he never asked us to bend to the system — the system bent to us.

faqs.q1: How long does a software project take?
faqs.a1: It depends on the number of features. An MVP with only the core features is much faster than a full version. In the free consultation I break the features down and give you an estimated timeline before we start.
faqs.q2: How does the payment process work?
faqs.a2: We typically use installment payments: 30% deposit upon signing, 40% at mid-development, and 30% upon project completion. Payment terms can be flexibly adjusted based on project needs.
faqs.q3: Do you provide maintenance after completion?
faqs.a3: Yes. Every project includes a free maintenance period during which bugs are fixed at no charge. Afterwards you can renew to keep releasing updates and adapting to system and platform changes, so everything stays stable.
faqs.q4: What makes you different from other freelancers?
faqs.a4: Three things: First, a full-stack technical capability so you don't need multiple people; second, proactive communication so you're never left in the dark; third, a complete post-launch maintenance period for peace of mind.

a4_cards.title: Full-Stack Capability
a4_cards.desc: I handle everything from frontend to backend. You don't need to hire separate developers. One person, full context, higher efficiency.

a4_cards.title: Proactive Communication
a4_cards.desc: I value transparency. Always reachable, regular updates. You will always know the project status and never feel left in the dark.

a4_cards.title: Post-Launch Support
a4_cards.desc: Launch is just the beginning. I provide a complete maintenance period to ensure stability. Any issues are checked and fixed immediately.

faqs.q5: What if I'm not satisfied during the process?
faqs.a5: Before formal development, I will provide design drafts for you to confirm the direction. There will also be phased demos and acceptance reviews during the development process. We can discuss the details further.
faqs.q6: What is Ark Studio (方舟工坊)?
faqs.a6: Ark Studio (方舟工坊) is a software development studio run by David. It helps individuals, startups and companies turn ideas into apps, websites, back-office systems and LINE bots. 9 years of full-stack experience, with several software products built and launched.
faqs.q7: I only have an idea, no designs and no software experience. Is that okay?
faqs.a7: Yes, most clients start this way. I will first help you clarify the problem to solve and the minimum features you need, then design and build it. You do not need to understand the technology first.
faqs.q8: Is releasing an app on the stores a hassle? Will you help?
faqs.a8: Yes. Store release involves a developer account, a privacy policy, screenshots and review replies. I help prepare the documents and handle review feedback. I recommend registering the developer account in your own name so you own the app.
faqs.a9: There is no fixed price. Cost depends mainly on the number of features, whether it is an app, a website or a back-office system, whether you need sign-in and an admin back office, and whether LINE or payment integrations are involved. In the free consultation I break the features down, suggest what to build first and quote by scope. Starting with an MVP usually keeps the initial investment low.
